question_variants: repeat customers versus one time buyers
how much comes from repeat business
sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
    SUM(oi.sale_price) AS spend
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS oi
  WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  GROUP BY oi.user_id)
SELECT CASE WHEN orders = 1 THEN 'single-order' ELSE 'repeat' END AS segment,
  COUNT(*) AS buyers,
  ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(spend), 2) AS avg_spend
FROM per_user GROUP BY segment ORDER BY revenue DESC
report: Uses a CTE to collapse to one row per buyer before segmenting. Segmenting on the raw item table would count a buyer once per item and distort every average.
